# BJM

> BJM is a medical billing and revenue cycle management partner that helps practices improve coding accuracy, clean claim rates, denial recovery, and A/R performance.

## Services

- [Medical Coding](https://veloq.tech/services/medical-coding): CPT, ICD-10, and HCPCS coding with specialty-aware review to maximize clean claims and reduce compliance risk.
- [Claim Submission](https://veloq.tech/services/claim-submission): End-to-end claim preparation, scrubbing, and electronic submission for higher first-pass acceptance.
- [Denial Management](https://veloq.tech/services/denial-management): Denial triage, appeals, and root-cause prevention that recovers revenue and stops repeat losses.
- [Eligibility & Benefits](https://veloq.tech/services/eligibility-benefits): Front-end verification that reduces surprise denials and improves point-of-service collections.
- [AR Follow-Up](https://veloq.tech/services/ar-followup): Disciplined accounts receivable follow-up that shortens days in A/R and recovers aging balances.
- [Credentialing & Full RCM](https://veloq.tech/services/credentialing-rcm): Provider enrollment plus full revenue cycle partnership from intake to cash.

## Focus Areas

CPT, ICD-10, HCPCS, EDI claims, clearinghouse workflows, eligibility, prior auth, denial codes, appeals, A/R aging, CAQH, credentialing, HIPAA-aware operations
